plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: context fill, last turn's cost, session cost and rate limits; /gauge toggles it

plugins.name: prompt-shaper
plugins.description: Expands your shorthand and attaches git state to each prompt; adds a stable project-toolchain note to the system prompt

plugins.name: long-turn-notify
plugins.description: macOS notification when a long turn finishes, or when Claude needs your input, in terminal sessions

plugins.name: merge-gate
plugins.description: Holds gh pr merge until CI passes on the PR head; /gate runs the project CI steps locally without a Claude turn

plugins.name: secret-scrubber
plugins.description: Masks API keys and tokens in tool output before Claude or the transcript sees them, and refuses writing them into source files

plugins.name: test-on-edit
plugins.description: When Claude's answer ends, runs the tests of the files it edited; failures go to Claude with your next prompt

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Suggests 2-3 likely next prompts after each turn, press 1/2/3 to draft one; /next off

plugins.name: mod-stats
plugins.description: /mod-stats [days]: what each mod did, cost and saved

plugins.name: mod-faults
plugins.description: Passively logs god-mods hook faults (skipped, expired, kept, caught, rejected) to ~/.claude/logs/god-mods-faults.jsonl; /mod-faults shows a summary

plugins.name: agent-spend
plugins.description: /spend [days] [here]: subagent spend by model and agent type, and the costliest agents, in a pane
